teaser: Three old iPhones and an iPad, synced live in Final Cut Pro: Apple's Live Multicam, found by accident.
core_idea: A producer filmed a three-camera music video with two second-hand iPhone 12s and an iPhone 13 connected to an iPad running Final Cut Pro. Apple's Live Multicam, released in June 2024 with the free Final Cut Camera app, records up to four angles in sync, transfers the full-quality files afterwards, and moves to Final Cut Pro on the Mac. He found it by accident, which suggests many who could use it do not know it exists.
